# AE Survey · Agri Experience Field Operations

> AE Survey is an offline-first agricultural field enumeration, survey design, and real-time analytics platform for Agri Experience Limited.

## Core Interfaces
- [Operations Studio](https://ae-survey.pages.dev/): Management portal for survey design, team task assignment, and agronomic analytics.
- [Mobile Field Collector](https://ae-survey.pages.dev/field.html): Dedicated offline PWA for agricultural enumerators and extension officers.
